raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 1, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted attendee relationships and quantities—treated the grandma’s brother’s daughter (an adult) as a second cousin who doesn’t eat carbs (it’s her 3 kids), counted 12 adults instead of 11, counted all 6 kids instead of only 3 eating, and used 0.25 lb per potato instead of the stated 0.5 lb—leading to 1 bag instead of the correct 2.
